claim: The port/splitter carries three slots, and the split is spectral rather than by intensity: one slot is empty and sends light to the red camera only, one holds a 561 nm dichroic and sends light to both cameras in different bands, and one holds a 100/0 mirror and sends light to the blue camera only. Two of the three states therefore send zero light to one camera. Which physical slot is at which position number is not known.
validity_conditions: This instrument as configured on 2026-09-17, operator read at the instrument. 561 carries no numbers[] entry: it is the dichroic's nominal designation, a string identifier that is exact by definition, and the measured edge of its transmission curve is a different quantity that nobody here has measured (5.3). Slot contents only: the slot ORDER is not part of this claim and is recorded as a gap, not estimated. Because two states starve one camera, a position number read back from the driver does not establish which element is in the beam -- that is settled by acquiring, not by read-back. Falsified by re-fitting any slot.
